Reviewed 2026-09-08. Current project constraints:
- Resource-scoped optimistic concurrency is implemented. Treat project_state.revision as a notification cursor; mutations use per-resource versions, atomic read/write guards and idempotent operation ids. Advisory intents do not grant write authority. Do not reintroduce silent last-write-wins.
- Compact MCP contract v2 is documented in docs/context-efficiency.md: apply injectionPrompt once at every required hook, use section metadata for caching, retrieve task details explicitly, and follow bounded summary pages with validated state filters and cursors.
- Startup supplies the full required protocol/guidance, a current summary within 2,000 characters and a bounded design index; historical handovers require explicit retrieval. Keep summaries current and notes important, complete and non-routine. Only an authorized coordinator replaces the versioned summary or resolves reviewed note ids; retain provenance within retention limits.
- Preserve narrow design tools, closed operation schemas, generated Structurizr protection, and the separation of UML artifacts from UI mockups. Publish portable nonnegative integer constraints for count schemas.
- The stdio MCP server has its own lifecycle, separate from the desktop UI. Rebuild and reconnect clients when changing its binary or schemas. NSIS is configured perMachine; user settings remain under LocalAppData/Adashi, separate from installed binaries.
- The three resolved handovers and former summary are historical evidence, not current task/build/process status. Consult source, linked formal design and current validation for later changes.
